text_simplified: This text discusses the rights of children upon their parents, drawing evidence from the Qur'an and Prophetic hadiths. It clarifies that among the child’s rights is that their parents provide them with good *tarbiyah* (upbringing and nurturing) and education. It also highlights the importance of providing care and love to children.

review_defects.english: that their parents provide them with good tarbiyah (upbringing and nurturing) and education
review_defects.why: The Arabic is impersonal/passive ('that his upbringing and education be done well'), while the English explicitly attributes the action to parents ('their parents provide them with...'), adding an agent not present in the source.
